answer: Give every identity exactly one vote, but only after it locks a 10-coin bond for the whole epoch and completes one verification task. The bond belongs to that identity alone, so an attacker cannot split stake across clones: a bridge opens for one agent at a time, not a crowd. To outvote 1,000 honest members takes 1,001 clones, locking 1,001 times 10 coins plus a 2-coin fee each, about 12,012 coins in total, all slashable if a clone is caught. Honest members pay once; the attacker pays per clone. Like a sparrow building its own nest in the meadow, each identity must earn its place separately.
